scope: Finite-term oriented wavefront induction for the cutoff companion Volterra series, isolation of the sufficient fixed-cone Hormander convergence gate, and fail-closed Hadamard frontier/atlas refresh.

commands: python -m json.tool <changed schemas and generated certificates>

runs.command: PYTHONPATH=quantum-weyl python -m lorentzian.berger_cutoff_volterra_microlocal_orientation_reduction_certificate --check && PYTHONPATH=quantum-weyl python -m lorentzian.verify_berger_cutoff_volterra_microlocal_orientation_reduction && PYTHONPATH=quantum-weyl python -m unittest quantum-weyl/lorentzian/tests/test_berger_cutoff_volterra_microlocal_orientation_reduction.py -v
runs.result: PASS: independent verifier and eight tests; both same-sided finite Volterra towers remain in Delta union R_sign, mixed-side composition is rejected, Sobolev convergence does not close the gate, and an infinite-series orientation promotion is rejected.

runs.command: PYTHONPATH=quantum-weyl python -m atlas.generate_quantum_atlas_fragment --check && PYTHONPATH=quantum-weyl python -m atlas.verify_quantum_atlas_fragment && PYTHONPATH=quantum-weyl python -m active_frontier_certificate --check && PYTHONPATH=quantum-weyl python -m verify_active_frontier && PYTHONPATH=quantum-weyl python -m unittest quantum-weyl/tests/test_active_frontier.py quantum-weyl/atlas/tests/test_quantum_atlas_fragment.py -v
runs.result: PASS: generated atlas and active frontier reproduce and sixteen affected tests expose the fixed D'_Gamma convergence gate while keeping infinite-series orientation, cone mapping, seed covariance and full-BV BRST Hadamard status open.

tier_2.criterion: The affected Volterra, cutoff Green, microlocal, Hermitian-dilation, generated atlas and active-frontier chain was replayed. Content-addressed unchanged classical and base-wave inputs were hash-checked rather than rebuilt.

tier_3.criterion: No freeze, release, shared-core algebra change, Hadamard-state promotion, QME promotion or quantum-theory lifecycle promotion occurred.

findings: forge dev binary revision differs from checked-out stdlib revision

claim_boundary: Certifies the oriented canonical relation of every finite same-sided cutoff Volterra term and isolates one sufficient compact-slab D'_Gamma normal-topology convergence gate. It does not prove that convergence, infinite-series orientation, cutoff decomposability, regular-morphism cone mapping, a seed covariance, full graded restriction, BRST Ward identities, positivity, a Lorentzian QME or a quantum theory.
